name: sundial-tip-art
note: Three options (a, b, c) per slot. Keep the one chosen per slot and delete the others. All art is original and transparent; the teal #7FD8DE card behind it is existing UI.

format.primary: Animated SVG: self-contained, CSS keyframes inside, no JS, no external assets, transparent background
format.fallback: PNG @3x, transparent, static pose (same as prefers-reduced-motion)
format.reducedMotion: Built into each SVG via @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)
format.font: Letters/numbers in SVG text use 'Archivo Black', falling back to 'Arial Black'. When loaded with , web fonts are not available inside the SVG, so the fallback shows.

palette.shadow: hard offset 1.6 units down-right, #1A1A1C at 20% opacity

slots.placement: Bottom teal tip card, the 'character art — drop here' area directly above the white sign '5 SUBMITTERS SO FAR'

slots.screen: Voter waiting screen — 'You're in' with the countdown 'Until voting opens'
slots.placement: Teal tip card below the countdown, the art area directly above the white sign 'KEEP THIS PAGE OPEN ON FRIDAY'

slots.screen: Phone countdown screen — 'Here we go' with the circular 'STARTING' countdown
slots.placement: Bottom teal tip card, the art area directly above the white sign 'EYES ON THE TV'
Top banner. This is the DEFAULT only: if the admin uploaded a banner in Event details, show that image instead.
